tooltip: Use: Summons a Reagent Bot that allows you and others nearby to purchase reagents. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hr. (60 Min Cooldown)

legacyPerks.name: Performance Bonus
legacyPerks.description: You have a 15% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant's Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.

legacyPerks.name: Working Overtime
legacyPerks.description: Increases your chance to gain a skill increase from using any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill by 20%.

legacyPerks.name: Dedicated Study
legacyPerks.description: Increases your skill by 1 in your lowest tradeskill among your Primary and Secondary tradeskills. If you have already reached 300 skill in your two current Primary Tradeskills and all three Secondary Tradeskills, you will gain 2 to 4 of a random Elemental Essence.
